G2500.def: perhaps for «2501»; Joses, the name of two Israelites:--Joses. Compare «2499».

G2501.def: of Hebrew origin («03130»); Joseph, the name of seven Israelites:--Joseph.

G2502.def: of Hebrew origin («02977»); Josias (i.e. Joshiah), an Israelite:--Josias.

G2503.et: of Hebrew origin [the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet]
G2503.def: of Hebrew origin (the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet); "iota", the name of the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, put (figuratively) for a very small part of anything:--jot.

G2504.et: from (2532) and (1473) (so also the dative case kamoi {kam-oy'}, and accusative case kame {kam-eh'}
G2504.def: from «2532» and «1473»; so also the dative case kamoi kam-oy', and accusative case kame kam-eh' and (or also, even, etc.) I, (to) me:--(and, even, even so, so) I (also, in like wise), both me, me also.

G2505.et: from (2596) and the neuter plural of (3739)
G2505.def: from «2596» and the neuter plural of «3739»; according to which things, i.e. just as:--as.

G2506.def: from «2507»; demolition; figuratively, extinction:--destruction, pulling down.

G2507.def: from «2596» and «138» (including its alternate); to lower (or with violence) demolish (literally or figuratively):--cast (pull, put, take) down, destroy.

G2508.def: from «2513»; to cleanse, i.e. (specially) to prune; figuratively, to expiate:--purge.

G2509.pos: 1. according as, just as, even as
G2509.def: from «2505» and «4007»; exactly as:--(even, as well) as.

G2510.def: from «2596» and «680»; to seize upon:--fasten on.

G2511.def: from «2513»; to cleanse (literally or figuratively):--(make) clean(-se), purge, purify.

G2512.def: from «2511»; a washing off, i.e. (ceremonially) ablution, (morally) expiation:--cleansing, + purge, purification(-fying).

G2513.def: of uncertain affinity; clean (literally or figuratively):--clean, clear, pure.

G2515.def: from «2596» and the same as «1476»; a bench (literally or figuratively):--seat.

G2516.def: from «2596» and the base of «1476»; to sit down:--sit.

G2517.def: from «2596» and «1836»; thereafter, i.e. consecutively; as a noun (by ellipsis of noun) a subsequent person or time:--after(-ward), by (in) order.

G2518.def: from «2596» and heudo (to sleep); to lie down to rest, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep (literally or figuratively):--(be a-)sleep.

G2519.def: from a compound of «2596» and «2233»; a guide, i.e. (figuratively) a teacher:--master.

G2520.def: from «2596» and «2240»; to reach to, i.e. (neuter of present active participle, figuratively as adjective) becoming:-- convenient, fit.

G2521.et: from (2596), and hemai (to sit, akin to the base of (1476))
G2521.def: from «2596»; and hemai (to sit; akin to the base of «1476»); to sit down; figuratively, to remain, reside:--dwell, sit (by, down).

G2523.def: another (active) form for «2516»; to seat down, i.e. set (figuratively, appoint); intransitively, to sit (down); figuratively, to settle (hover, dwell):--continue, set, sit (down), tarry.

G2524.def: from «2596»; and hiemi (to send); to lower:--let down.

G2525.def: from «2596» and «2476»; to place down (permanently), i.e. (figuratively) to designate, constitute, convoy:--appoint, be, conduct, make, ordain, set.

G2526.def: from «2596» and «3739»; according to which thing, i.e. precisely as, in proportion as:--according to that, (inasmuch) as.

G2527.def: from «2596» and «3650»; on the whole, i.e. entirely:--at all.

G2528.def: from «2596»; and «3695»; to equip fully with armor:--arm.

G2529.def: from «2596» and «3708»; to behold fully, i.e. (figuratively) distinctly apprehend:--clearly see.

G2530.def: from «2596»; and «3739» and «5100»; according to which certain thing, i.e. as far (or inasmuch) as:--(according, forasmuch) as, because (that).

G2531.def: from «2596» and «5613»; just (or inasmuch) as, that:--according to, (according, even) as, how, when.

G2532.et: apparently, a primary particle, having a copulative and sometimes also a cumulative force
G2532.def: apparently, a primary particle, having a copulative and sometimes also a cumulative force; and, also, even, so then, too, etc.; often used in connection (or composition) with other particles or small words:--and, also, both, but, even, for, if, or, so, that, then, therefore, when, yet.

G2533.def: of Chaldee origin; the dell; Caiaphas (i.e. Cajepha), an Israelite:--Caiaphas.

G2534.def: from «2532» and «1065»; and at least (or even, indeed):--and, at least.

G2535.def: of Hebrew origin («07014»); Cain, (i.e. Cajin), the son of Adam:--Cain.

G2536.def: of Hebrew origin («07018»); Cainan (i.e. Kenan), the name of two patriarchs:--Cainan.

G2537.def: of uncertain affinity; new (especially in freshness; while «3501» is properly so with respect to age:--new.

G2539.def: from «2532» and «4007»; and indeed, i.e. nevertheless or notwithstanding:--and yet, although.

G2540.def: of uncertain affinity; an occasion, i.e. set or proper time:--X always, opportunity, (convenient, due) season, (due, short, while) time, a while. Compare «5550».

G2541.def: of Latin origin; Caesar, a title of the Roman emperor:--Caesar.

G2542.def: from «2541»; Caesaria, the name of two places in Palestine:--Caesarea.

G2543.def: from «2532» and «5104»; and yet, i.e. nevertheless:--although.

G2544.def: from «2543» and «1065»; and yet indeed, i.e. although really:--nevertheless, though.

G2545.def: apparently a primary verb; to set on fire, i.e. kindle or (by implication) consume:--burn, light.

G2546.def: from «2532» and «1563»; likewise in that place:--and there, there (thither) also.

G2547.def: from «2532» and «1564»; likewise from that place (or time):--and afterward (from) (thence), thence also.

G2548.def: from «2532» and «1565»; likewise that (or those):--and him (other, them), even he, him also, them (also), (and) they.

G2549.def: from «2556»; badness, i.e. (subjectively) depravity, or (actively) malignity, or (passively) trouble:--evil, malice(-iousness), naughtiness, wickedness.

G2550.def: from a compound of «2556» and «2239»; bad character, i.e. (specially) mischievousness:--malignity.

G2551.def: from a compound of «2556» and «3056»; to revile:--curse, speak evil of.

G2552.def: from a compound of «2256» and «3806»; hardship:--suffering affliction.

G2553.def: from the same as «2552»; to undergo hardship:--be afflicted, endure afflictions (hardness), suffer trouble.

G2554.def: from «2555»; to be a bad-doer, i.e. (objectively) to injure, or (genitive) to sin:--do(ing) evil.

G2555.def: from «2556» and «4160»; a bad-doer; (specially), a criminal:--evil-doer, malefactor.

G2556.def: apparently a primary word; worthless (intrinsically, such; whereas «4190» properly refers to effects), i.e. (subjectively) depraved, or (objectively) injurious:--bad, evil, harm, ill, noisome, wicked.

G2557.def: from «2556» and the base of «2041»; a wrong-doer, i.e. criminal:--evil-doer, malefactor.

G2558.et: from a presumed compound of (2556) and (2192)
G2558.def: from a presumed compound of «2556» and «2192»; to maltreat:--which suffer adversity, torment.

G2559.def: from «2556»; to injure; figuratively, to exasperate:--make evil affected, entreat evil, harm, hurt, vex.

G2560.def: from «2556»; badly (physically or morally):--amiss, diseased, evil, grievously, miserably, sick, sore.

G2562.def: feminine of «2563»; a stalk of grain, i.e. (collectively) stubble:--stubble.

G2563.def: or uncertain affinity; a reed (the plant or its stem, or that of a similar plant); by implication, a pen:--pen, reed.

G2564.def: akin to the base of «2753»; to "call" (properly, aloud, but used in a variety of applications, directly or otherwise):--bid, call (forth), (whose, whose sur-)name (was (called)).

G2565.def: from the base of «2566» and «1636»; a cultivated olive tree, i.e. a domesticated or improved one:--good olive tree.

G2566.def: neuter of the (irregular) comparative of «2570»; (adverbially) better than many:--very well.

G2567.def: from «2570» and «1320»; a teacher of the right:--teacher of good things.

G2568.def: plural of «2570» and «3040»; Good Harbors, i.e. Fairhaven, a bay of Crete:--fair havens.

G2569.def: from «2570» and «4160»; to do well, i.e. live virtuously:--well doing.

G2570.def: of uncertain affinity; properly, beautiful, but chiefly (figuratively) good (literally or morally), i.e. valuable or virtuous (for appearance or use, and thus distinguished from «18», which is properly intrinsic):--X better, fair, good(-ly), honest, meet, well, worthy.

G2572.def: akin to «2813» and «2928»; to cover up (literally or figuratively):--cover, hide.

G2573.def: adverb from «2570»; well (usually morally):--(in a) good (place), honestly, + recover, (full) well.

G2576.et: from a compound of (2596) and the base of (3466)
G2576.def: from a compound of «2596» and the base of «3466»; to shut down, i.e. close the eyes:--close.

G2577.def: apparently a primary verb; properly, to toil, i.e. (by implication) to tire (figuratively, faint, sicken):--faint, sick, be wearied.

G2578.def: apparently a primary verb; to bend:--bow.

G2579.pos:
1. and if
  2. also or even if
    1. of only, at least
    2. even if
G2579.def: from «2532» and «1437»; and (or even) if:--and (also) if (so much as), if but, at the least, though, yet.

G2580.def: of Hebrew origin (compare «07071»); Cana, a place in Palestine:--Cana.

G2581.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «07067»); zealous; Cananites, an epithet:--Canaanite (by mistake for a derivative from «5477»).

G2582.def: of foreign origin:--Candace, an Egyptian queen:--Candace.

G2583.et: from kane (a straight reed, i.e. rod)
G2583.def: from kane (a straight reed, i.e. rod); a rule ("canon"), i.e. (figuratively) a standard (of faith and practice); by implication, a boundary, i.e. (figuratively) a sphere (of activity):--line, rule.

G2584.def: of Hebrew origin (probably «03723» and «05151»); Capernaum (i.e. Caphanachum), a place in Palestine:--Capernaum.

G2585.def: from kapelos (a huckster); to retail, i.e. (by implication) to adulterate (figuratively):--corrupt.

G2587.def: of foreign origin; Cappadocia, a region of Asia Minor:--Cappadocia.

G2588.et: prolonged from a primary kar (Latin, cor, "heart")
G2588.def: prolonged from a primary kar (Latin cor, "heart"); the heart, i.e. (figuratively) the thoughts or feelings (mind); also (by analogy) the middle:--(+ broken-)heart(-ed).

G2589.def: from «2588» and «1097»; a heart-knower:--which knowest the hearts.

G2590.def: probably from the base of «726»; fruit (as plucked), literally or figuratively:--fruit.

G2591.def: perhaps for «2590»; Carpus, probably a Christian:--Carpus.

G2592.def: from «2593»; to be fertile (literally or figuratively):--be (bear, bring forth) fruit(-ful).

G2594.def: from a derivative of «2904» (transposed); to be strong, i.e. (figuratively) steadfast (patient):--endure.

G2595.def: from karpho (to wither); a dry twig or straw:--mote.

G2596.def: a primary particle; (prepositionally) down (in place or time), in varied relations (according to the case (genitive, dative or accusative) with which it is joined):--about, according as (to), after, against, (when they were) × alone, among, and, × apart, (even, like) as (concerning, pertaining to touching), × aside, at, before, beyond, by, to the charge of, (charita-)bly, concerning, + covered, (dai-)ly, down, every, (+ far more) exceeding, × more excellent, for, from ... to, godly, in(-asmuch, divers, every, -to, respect of), ... by, after the manner of, + by any means, beyond (out of) measure, × mightily, more, × natural, of (up-)on (X part), out (of every), over against, (+ your) × own, +

G2597.def: from «2596» and the base of «939»; to descend (literally or figuratively):--come (get, go, step) down, fall (down).

G2598.def: from «2596» and «906»; to throw down:--cast down, lay.
